noise_model.pauli_convention: with probability p a uniformly random non-identity Pauli is applied; for a two-qubit gate p equals the average gate infidelity, for a one-qubit gate the infidelity is 2p/3

simulation.rus_runs: one Pauli-trajectory sample per shot at both register sizes (structured branch simulator, validated against a dense statevector per error pattern and against the exact density matrix in the mean)
simulation.noisy_p0_at_true_pose: exact 512x512 density matrix at 9 qubits; 1000-trajectory mean at 17 qubits

noise_model.lock_rule: lower one-sided 95% bound on the measured P(0) >= 0.90

h2_spec.source: Quantinuum System Model H2 Product Data Sheet v2.00 (October 2024), docs.quantinuum.com
